metadata.citation: Ilford, ILFORD XP2 SUPER Technical Information, November 2018, page 2 wedge spectrogram and page 3 characteristic curve; standard C-41, representative of 35mm and roll film.
metadata.datasource: https://125px.com/docs/film/ilford/XP2-Super_201811.pdf; PDF SHA256 695a2d3d54f11cb8b24f6d040a9723a16819001a38715f2bd6f71f2d05cdc549; source SHA256 141e03811b270c526528da07feead5af880ccdc69804946a7626442f62b7716c. Standard C-41 colour-negative process; curve representative of 35mm and roll film; no development time is printed. Source-relative log-exposure reference 3.04219166521 on the page-3 Relative log exposure axis; this is not an absolute lux-seconds origin. Rebuild scripts/prepare_xp2.py; see docs/xp2super400.md. Publication plots are embedded raster images, not vector curves. The spectral ordinate is printed only as 'Sensitivity' with 0.5/1.0 ticks; the linear zero-based reading is an explicit interpretation, not a Harman statement. The page-2 ordinate is a 2856 K tungsten wedge response; no equal-energy correction or source spectrum is supplied, so relative_sensitivity is not equal-energy film sensitivity. The 380-355 nm and 660-780 nm tails are endpoint-slope extrapolations, not measured. No RMS granularity or MTF figure is published on the XP2 sheet; grain must be a class-level approximation, not a measured RMS. XP2 is a chromogenic dye B&W film: the image is formed by dyes, not silver. The negative is pink/red-brown and the datasheet recommends C-41. No base spectrum, halation PSF, scanner response or absolute ISO calibration is supplied. The characteristic curve is representative of 35mm and roll film; no separate 120/sheet calibration is provided. No RMS granularity or MTF is published; the Dye grain preset is a class-level approximation, not a measured RMS. XP2 is a dye image, not a silver image; the pink/red-brown negative and C-41 process are explicit model context. C-41 development time is not printed; development_time=[0.0] is a placeholder, not a time calibration. Exposure zero is the first plotted density plus 1.0; that density is not a measured D-min. The characteristic curve clamps outside the plotted range; no inferred shoulder or extra latitude. Real scans are qualitative only and cannot establish scanner-independent physical fidelity.
